title: Order Statistics on the Graph
statement: The task is to answer q ≤ 10^5 queries on a directed graph of n ≤ 20 vertices where each second every vertex takes the k_v-th smallest value among its in-neighbours: given initial values, report them after t ≤ 10^18 seconds. Thresholding at each value turns the state into an n-bit bitmask, so answers come from a functional graph on 2^n masks with cycle detection and binary lifting.
